"""Ask the existing registered launcher to price the exact 36-cell screen."""

import json
from pathlib import Path
import shlex
import subprocess
import sys

from rich.console import Console
from bio_inspired_nanochat.ablation_matrix import d1_screening_columns, SCREENING_SEEDS
from bio_inspired_nanochat.common import get_base_dir
from bio_inspired_nanochat.matrix_manifest import load_manifest, registered_tokens


pilot_file, input_file, output_file = map(Path, sys.argv[1:])
pilot = load_manifest(pilot_file)
inputs = json.loads(input_file.read_text())
recipe = dict(pilot["recipe"])
batch = int(recipe["total_batch_size"])
tokens = registered_tokens("screening", batch)
recipe["num_iterations"] = str(tokens // batch)
assert tokens == 9961472
cells = len(d1_screening_columns()) * len(SCREENING_SEEDS)
assert cells == 36 and pilot["world_size"] == 2 and pilot["bpb_only"]
command = [sys.executable, "-m", "scripts.matrix_launch", "--stage", "screening",
           "--nproc", "2", "--plan", "--bpb-only",
           "--cap-gpu-hours", "72", "--tok-per-sec", str(inputs["observed_train_rate"]),
           "--score-seconds-per-cell", str(inputs["score_seconds"]),
           f"--recipe={shlex.join(f'--{key}={value}' for key, value in recipe.items())}"]
training = 2 * cells * tokens / inputs["observed_train_rate"] / 3600
scoring = cells * inputs["score_seconds"] / 3600
path_set_before = set(Path(get_base_dir()).glob("matrix_runs/*/manifest.json"))
result = subprocess.run(command, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, text=True, check=False)
Console().file.write(result.stdout)
path_set_after = set(Path(get_base_dir()).glob("matrix_runs/*/manifest.json"))
if training + scoring > 72:
    assert result.returncode == 2 and "registered plan exceeds the aggregate device-hour cap" in result.stdout
    assert path_set_before == path_set_after
else:
    assert result.returncode == 0
    frozen_path, = path_set_after - path_set_before
    frozen = load_manifest(frozen_path)
    assert frozen["registered"] and frozen["columns"] == [column.config_id for column in d1_screening_columns()]
    assert frozen["bpb_only"] and frozen["tokens_per_cell"] == tokens and frozen["data"] == pilot["data"]
with output_file.open("x") as stream:
    json.dump({
        "argv": command,
        "cells": cells,
        "training_tokens_per_cell": tokens,
        "inputs": inputs,
        "training_gpu_hours": training,
        "scoring_gpu_hours": scoring,
        "total_gpu_hours": training + scoring,
        "training_only_minimum_rate_for_72_gpu_hours": 2 * cells * tokens / (72 * 3600),
        "cap_gpu_hours": 72,
        "launcher_exit": result.returncode,
        "new_registered_manifest": bool(path_set_after - path_set_before),
        "launcher_output": result.stdout,
    }, stream, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False)
    stream.write("\n")

"""Run the production dual-GPU trainer and single-GPU BPB scorer for admission."""

import json
import math
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shlex
import subprocess
import sys
import time

from rich.console import Console
from bio_inspired_nanochat.matrix_manifest import dataset_identity, file_digest, load_manifest


base, output = map(Path, sys.argv[1:3])
arms = sys.argv[3].split(",")
console = Console()
train_recipe = json.loads(Path("results/fineweb_accelerated_2026-11-24.json").read_text())[
    "checkpoint_recount"
]["manifest"]["recipe"]
train_recipe["num_iterations"] = "8"
expected_data = json.loads(Path("results/vanilla_pilot_2026-11-22.json").read_text())["budget"]["input_identity"]
assert dataset_identity() == expected_data
recipe = [f"--{key}={value}" for key, value in train_recipe.items()]
launch = [sys.executable, "-m", "scripts.matrix_launch", "--stage", "screening", "--exploratory",
          "--columns", ",".join(arms), "--seeds", "1337", "--nproc", "2", "--bpb-only",
          "--cap-gpu-hours", "0.5", "--execute", f"--recipe={shlex.join(recipe)}"]
scorer = None
with subprocess.Popen(launch, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, text=True, bufsize=1) as child:
    assert child.stdout is not None
    for line in child.stdout:
        console.file.write(line)
        console.file.flush()
        if line.startswith(shlex.join([sys.executable, "-m", "scripts.eval_matrix", "matrix"]) + " "):
            assert scorer is None
            scorer = shlex.split(line)
    if code := child.wait():
        raise subprocess.CalledProcessError(code, launch)
assert scorer is not None and "--bpb-only" in scorer
manifest_path = Path(scorer[scorer.index("--matrix-manifest") + 1])
manifest = load_manifest(manifest_path)
assert manifest["data"] == expected_data and manifest["recipe"] == train_recipe
assert manifest["columns"] == arms and manifest["seeds"] == [1337] and manifest["world_size"] == 2
assert manifest["tokens_per_cell"] == 8 * 65536 and not manifest["registered"]
attempts_path = manifest_path.with_name("attempts.jsonl")
attempts = [json.loads(line) for line in attempts_path.read_text().splitlines()]
assert len(attempts) == 2 * len(arms)
output.mkdir()
for arm in arms:
    score = scorer.copy()
    score[score.index("--presets") + 1] = arm
    out = output / arm
    score[score.index("--out-dir") + 1] = str(out)
    started = time.monotonic()
    subprocess.run(score, env={**os.environ, "CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES": "0"}, check=True, timeout=360)
    elapsed = time.monotonic() - started
    summary, = out.rglob("summary.jsonl")
    row, = [json.loads(line) for line in summary.read_text().splitlines()]
    assert row["preset"] == arm and row["seed"] == 1337 and row["status"] == "ok"
    assert row["matrix_manifest_digest"] == manifest["run_id"]
    assert row["train_world_size"] == 2 and row["world_size"] == 1
    assert row["train_tokens_processed"] == 8 * 65536 and row["eval_tokens_processed"] == 1048576
    assert math.isfinite(row["val_bpb"]) and set(row["capability_metric_status"].values()) == {"not_run"}
    checkpoint = base / "base_checkpoints" / manifest["checkpoint_template"].format(preset=arm, seed=1337)
    weight_hash = file_digest(checkpoint / "model_000008.pt")
    assert weight_hash == row["model_file_sha256"]
    assert row["eval_data_digest"] == expected_data["val_sha256"]
    assert row["tokenizer_digest"] == expected_data["tokenizer_sha256"]
    provenance = json.loads((checkpoint / "meta_000008.json").read_text())
    if arm != "vanilla":
        # The manifest-bound scorer also checks the checkpoint's resolved flags.
        flags = manifest["column_flags"][arm]
        assert flags["syn_cfg.native_presyn"].lower() in {"false", "0"}
        assert flags["syn_cfg.native_genetics"].lower() in {"false", "0"}
    row = {"score_cli_wall_seconds": elapsed, "row": row, "argv": score, "model_hash": weight_hash,
           "summary_sha256": file_digest(summary), "training_metadata": {
               "loop_state": provenance["loop_state"], "matrix_optimizer_names": provenance["matrix_optimizer_names"],
               "model_config": provenance["model_config"],
           }}
    with (output / f"{arm}.json").open("x") as stream:
        json.dump(row, stream, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False)
        stream.write("\n")
    console.print(f"{arm} BPB-only scorer completed in {elapsed:.3f} seconds")
with (output / "run.json").open("x") as stream:
    json.dump({"manifest": manifest, "attempts": attempts, "train_launch": launch}, stream, sort_keys=True)
    stream.write("\n")

"""Score the completed vanilla checkpoint after a bounded reference pilot stops."""

import json
import math
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import time

from rich.console import Console
from bio_inspired_nanochat.matrix_manifest import file_digest, load_manifest


base, pilot_receipt, output = map(Path, sys.argv[1:])
script_dir = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
receipt = json.loads(pilot_receipt.read_text())
assert receipt["status"] == "failure"
check, = receipt["details"]["checks"]
log_path = Path(check["log_path"])
assert check["log_sha256"] == file_digest(log_path)
manifest_path, = base.glob("matrix_runs/*/manifest.json")
manifest = load_manifest(manifest_path)
attempts = [json.loads(line) for line in manifest_path.with_name("attempts.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()]
assert [(event["event"], event.get("exit")) for event in attempts] == [
    ("start", None), ("end", 0), ("start", None), ("end", 137),
]
assert "got signal: 15" in log_path.read_text()
assert 895 < attempts[1]["seconds"] + attempts[3]["seconds"] < 900
output.mkdir()
recipe = manifest["recipe"]
command = [sys.executable, "-m", "scripts.eval_matrix", "matrix", "--device-type", "cuda",
           "--presets", "vanilla", "--seeds", "1337",
           "--checkpoint-dir", str(base / "base_checkpoints" / manifest["checkpoint_template"]),
           "--checkpoint-step", recipe["num_iterations"], "--matrix-manifest", str(manifest_path),
           "--eval-bpb", "--bpb-only", "--data", "fineweb", "--fail-fast",
           "--device-batch-size", recipe["device_batch_size"], "--eval-tokens", recipe["eval_tokens"],
           "--out-dir", str(output / "score")]
start = time.monotonic()
subprocess.run(command, check=True, timeout=360, env={**os.environ, "CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES": "0"})
elapsed = time.monotonic() - start
summary, = (output / "score").rglob("summary.jsonl")
row, = [json.loads(line) for line in summary.read_text().splitlines()]
assert row["preset"] == "vanilla" and row["seed"] == 1337 and row["status"] == "ok"
assert row["matrix_manifest_digest"] == manifest["run_id"] and math.isfinite(row["val_bpb"])
assert row["train_tokens_processed"] == 8 * 65536 and row["eval_tokens_processed"] == 1048576
assert row["train_world_size"] == 2 and row["world_size"] == 1
assert row["eval_data_digest"] == manifest["data"]["val_sha256"]
assert row["tokenizer_digest"] == manifest["data"]["tokenizer_sha256"]
assert set(row["capability_metric_status"].values()) == {"not_run"}
weight = base / "base_checkpoints" / manifest["checkpoint_template"].format(preset="vanilla", seed=1337) / "model_000008.pt"
assert file_digest(weight) == row["model_file_sha256"]
with (output / "vanilla.json").open("x") as stream:
    json.dump({"score_cli_wall_seconds": elapsed, "row": row, "argv": command,
               "summary_sha256": file_digest(summary),
               "summary_csv_sha256": file_digest(summary.with_suffix(".csv"))}, stream, sort_keys=True)
    stream.write("\n")
print(f"Vanilla checkpoint BPB-only wall seconds: {elapsed:.3f}", file=Console().file, flush=True)

parsed = json.loads(subprocess.check_output(
    [sys.executable, str(script_dir / "summarize.py"), str(log_path), str(manifest_path), str(output)],
    text=True,
))
bio_updates = parsed["bio_all"]["updates"]
assert bio_updates
best_bio_update = min(update["seconds"] for update in bio_updates)
input_rate = manifest["total_batch_size"] / best_bio_update
inputs = {"observed_train_rate": input_rate, "score_seconds": elapsed, "bio_update_count": len(bio_updates),
          "train_basis": "Fastest completed reference bio_all update, including cold updates",
          "score_basis": "Matched vanilla BPB-only CLI on one GPU because the bio checkpoint was unavailable"}
with (output / "inputs.json").open("x") as stream:
    json.dump(inputs, stream, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False)
    stream.write("\n")
with (output / "parsed.json").open("x") as stream:
    json.dump(parsed, stream, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False)
    stream.write("\n")
assert input_rate < 2 * 36 * 9961472 / (72 * 3600)
subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(script_dir / "admit.py"), str(manifest_path),
                str(output / "inputs.json"), str(output / "admission.json")], check=True, timeout=120)

"""Read the real trainer's calibrated update and memory measurements."""

import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import statistics
import sys

log_text = Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text()
manifest = json.loads(Path(sys.argv[2]).read_text())
score_dir = Path(sys.argv[3])
batch = manifest["total_batch_size"]
train_world_size = manifest["world_size"]
assert batch == 65536 and train_world_size == 2
column_reports = {}
for arm in manifest["columns"]:
    tag = manifest["checkpoint_template"].format(preset=arm, seed=1337)
    prefixes = tuple(match.start() for match in re.finditer(rf"^torchrun [^\n]+--model_tag={tag}\b", log_text, re.M))
    if not prefixes:
        continue
    start, = prefixes
    end = log_text.find("\ntorchrun ", start + 1)
    section = log_text[start:] if end == -1 else log_text[start:end]
    observed = re.findall(
        r"^step (\d{5})/\d{5} .*?loss: ([\d.]+).*? dt: ([\d.]+)ms \| tok/sec: ([\d,]+)",
        section, re.M,
    )
    updates = []
    for step, loss, milliseconds, logged_rate in observed:
        seconds = float(milliseconds) / 1000
        rate = int(logged_rate.replace(",", ""))
        assert abs(rate - batch / seconds) < max(2, rate * 0.0003)
        updates.append({"step": int(step), "loss": float(loss), "seconds": seconds, "logged_aggregate_tok_s": rate})
    assert [row["step"] for row in updates] == list(range(len(updates)))
    post_two = [row["seconds"] for row in updates[2:]]
    memory = re.findall(r"^Peak memory usage: ([\d.]+)MiB", section, re.M)
    assert len(memory) <= 1
    score_path = score_dir / f"{arm}.json"
    score = json.loads(score_path.read_text()) if score_path.exists() else None
    column_reports[arm] = {
        "updates": updates,
        "post_first_two_update_count": len(post_two),
        "post_first_two_fastest_seconds": min(post_two) if post_two else None,
        "post_first_two_median_seconds": statistics.median(post_two) if post_two else None,
        "post_first_two_slowest_seconds": max(post_two) if post_two else None,
        "rank0_peak_allocated_mib": float(memory[0]) if memory else None,
        "score": score,
    }
print(json.dumps(column_reports, indent=2, allow_nan=False))
